title: Face Pull
summary: A rope pull from a high cable toward the face: rear delts 1, with upper back and mid/lower traps helping.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: The rear delts pull the upper arm back and out (horizontal abduction) with the elbows high.
Rhomboids and mid traps pull the shoulder blades together at the end.
Mid and lower traps help (0.5); the outward rotation at the end also works the rotator cuff, which the app does not track.

setup.text: Set the pulley at about head height with a rope.
Grip the rope with thumbs toward you, step back until the arms are straight.
Stand tall, or kneel, so the torso stays still.

form_cues.cue: Pull the rope toward your eyes
form_cues.why: High elbows keep the pull on the rear delts.
Pulling the rope apart at the end adds outward rotation.

form_cues.cue: Finish with elbows high and out
form_cues.why: Controlling the return keeps the load on.
Leaning turns it into a row.

bias_tweaks.change: Pulley lower (chest height), pull toward the upper chest
bias_tweaks.effect: Becomes more of a high row; more upper back.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Leaning back and using body weight to move the stack.
mistakes.fix: Use a lighter load you can pull with the torso still.
Keep the elbows at shoulder height.
This is a small-muscle exercise; use 12-20 reps.

misconceptions.reality: Light and heavy loads gave similar growth when sets were taken close to failure. Heavy loads build more strength.

lower_risk.text: The app adds no ramp-up sets here. If the muscle is not warm from earlier work, make the first set a little lighter.

Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2.5 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 2 reps in reserve in the 10-15 rep range. Low-risk to push close to failure.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Heavier rowing with the chest supported; more upper back (1).
Chest on an incline bench, raise in a Y: more lower traps.

notes: The app counts face pulls for rear delts, upper back and traps only.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
